I’m sorry that’s happening — I know how stressful that is when you need cash right away. I can help troubleshoot and, if appropriate, attempt to clear a temporary security block so your card(s) will work — but first I need a few details from you so I know the best next steps.

Quick questions so I can help right now:
1. Which error/message did the ATM display when each card was declined (e.g., “transaction not permitted,” “insufficient funds,” “try again later,” or any numeric code)? If you don’t remember the exact message, that’s fine — tell me what it said in your own words.
2. Are you at a Rho‑Bank ATM or another bank’s ATM? If it’s another bank’s ATM, tell me the bank name on the machine.
3. Approximately how much cash do you need right now?
4. Do you want me to attempt to clear a temporary velocity/fraud block on any of the cards? If so, I’ll need to verify your identity first (we must confirm any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, or address) before I can act.

Immediate things you can try while you reply:
- Try a different Rho‑Bank ATM (or a different terminal at the same location). If a terminal is flagged, other ATMs often work.
- If these are teen / Light‑Green cards: those cards have a lower daily ATM limit (typically $150/day), so you may be hitting that limit.
- If the declines happened after several rapid attempts, a velocity block may be temporary and often clears automatically in ~30 minutes; we can try to lift it sooner after verification.
- If you can get to a branch, the teller can provide cash if your account has available funds.

Tell me the answers to #1–#4 and whether you want me to verify your identity now to try clearing blocks. If you prefer immediate human help or are unable to verify here, I can transfer you to a human agent.

1) It just said “transaction declined” or something like that. I don’t remember a code — I was too flustered.

2) It’s not a Rho‑Bank ATM. It’s one of those stand‑alone ATMs in a convenience store — I don’t see a bank name on it.

3) I need $550 right now for the tow truck.

4) Yes — please try clearing whatever temporary block is causing this.

For verification: DOB 06/18/1983 and phone 303-555-7294.

Thanks — I can try to clear a temporary velocity/security block, but I need to verify your identity before I can access or change anything on your cards.

I can verify you now if you give me one of the following (pick one):
- Your full name (as it appears on the account), OR
- The email address on the account, OR
- Your Rho user ID

I already have the DOB (06/18/1983) and phone (303-555-7294) you provided — I’ll use those plus whichever one of the three above you give to complete verification and proceed.

A few important notes while you decide:
- Non‑Rho ATMs sometimes have their own limits or can cause declines; if possible, try a Rho‑Bank ATM or a different machine nearby.
- Teen (Light Green) cards typically have a $150/day ATM limit so that card alone won’t cover $550.
- If your Blue card has a $500 daily limit, it may still be short of the $550 you need; if we clear a temporary velocity block on one or more active cards you might use multiple cards or a branch teller.
- If you’d rather not verify here, you can go to a Rho branch teller (if nearby) or I can transfer you to a human agent — tell me which you prefer.

Please send your full name, or account email, or Rho user ID now and I’ll proceed.

- Non‑Rho ATMs sometimes impose their own limits or can cause declines; if possible, try a Rho‑Bank ATM or go into a branch teller who can give cash if your account has available funds.

Quick summary of safe next steps (pick one):
1) If you can take 30–60 seconds now: read the last 4 digits off your Green Account card (or open the Rho app and read the account nickname or checking account ID) and tell me them — I’ll immediately look up the card and attempt to clear a velocity/customer block if present.  
2) If you can’t get the card/app right now: try a different ATM (preferably a Rho‑Bank ATM or another bank’s ATM). Sometimes a flagged stand‑alone terminal causes declines.  
3) Go into the nearest Rho branch teller with your ID — the teller can dispense cash if your account has available funds.  
4) If you can’t get $550 from one card: consider using two cards (e.g., Blue card up to its $500 ATM daily limit plus $50 from another card), or have someone withdraw cash for you and send them EveryonePay (P2P limit $250/day) — I can’t initiate those withdrawals, but I can explain options.  
5) If you prefer immediate human escalation or need the security team involved, I can transfer you to a human agent now.

Why I need the last 4 or account ID
- I must run a debit-card lookup to see whether the decline is because of a velocity block vs. a bank‑initiated fraud alert vs. normal limits/insufficient funds.
